parameters.description:
`msg-to-parseplatform` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Parse Platform destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Parse Platform destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Parse Platform destinations bound per enrollment.

In your Parse Server dashboard — for example Back4App's App Settings → Security & Keys, or the masterKey set in a self-hosted Parse Server's config — copy the Master Key and set it as PARSEPLATFORM_MASTER_KEY. This service uses it to authenticate the administrative push-notification requests it makes to your app's installations.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Parse Platform destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Parse Platform push API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Parse Platform destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

base_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PARSEPLATFORM_BASE_URL value (same format as PARSEPLATFORM_BASE_URL)

master_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Parse Platform master key
